matrix_label: M5 Review-Request, Checks, and Merge-Queue Component Matrix — Approval Invalidation Banner Held

component_rows.scope_summary: Review-request row with provider identity and base/head relation explicit

component_rows.local_continue_fallback: Last-known provider fields labeled; local diff review continues offline

component_rows.local_continue_fallback: Last-known verdicts labeled stale; local re-run continues triage

component_rows.scope_summary: Pending-review tray with owner identity and local-versus-provider origin explicit

component_rows.browser_handoff_boundary: Opening a pending review on the provider is an explicit browser handoff
component_rows.local_continue_fallback: Last-known items labeled stale; local reviews continue offline

component_rows.scope_summary: Merge-readiness panel with blocking reasons explicit rather than one ready/not-ready pill

component_rows.scope_summary: Merge-queue entry with queue owner and position; provider queue state never flattened into a local estimate

component_rows.scope_summary: Approval-invalidation banner held pending upstream approval-recomputation graduation; no banner claim is offered while held and the review workspace continues to show last-known approval state labeled provider-backed
